name: Brynmoor
description: Starting south. Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, Whispering Swamp. Ruled by Velgar.

name: Ghornfell
description: North of Brynmoor. Garou land. Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, Bloodblight Swamp. Velgar's tower in the plains.

name: Fellhollow
description: Far north. Undead / Withering. Entry after Dragon Slayer via a necromantic door near Ashien's Watch. Soul-rifting to use spectral doors.

name: Dowdun Reach
description: Mountain keep of the Black Knights. South of Silverthorn Keep. Needs Withering Heights. Mithril tier.

name: Umbral Sands
description: Desert, east of the Bastion. Scorch by day, Fuzan by night. Needs Black Knight's Fortress.

name: Scorned Wilderness
description: 1.0 raid, not a normal overworld region. Floating islands. Entrance in north-west Fractured Plains after Icthlarin's Little Helper / Regicide.
danger: Raid (wiki stub; monsters listed as PL 9 in the walkthrough)

name: Temple Woods
description: Cliff sanctuary. Temple of Saradomin is the expedition base. Haunted windmill north-west.

name: Bramblemead Valley
description: Ruined human town, Keep of Blue Flames, two guilds. Goblins and rats.
resources: Same starter set; clay in the valley

name: Whispering Swamp
description: Buffer to Ghornfell. Slow going. Herbs and cave ore. Goblins, garou watch, night horror.

name: Fractured Plains
description: Garou hunting ground. Velgar's tower (Brakka's Folly). Anima-coloured plants.

name: Stormtouched Highlands
description: Permanent lightning storm. Wyrm bones. Garou king monument.

name: Bloodblight Swamp
description: Velgar's poisoned blood. Toxic air and water.

name: Forgotten Temple
description: Underground door from Fractured Plains. Death, Muncher, Postie Pete.

name: Bleakfields Valley
description: First undead valley. Withered village, graveyard, willow, Ravanna's stones.

name: Lake of Lost Souls
description: Noumenon-poisoned water.

name: Dragon's Run
description: North-west. Green dragon. Grave Run agility course.

name: Emberwood
description: Sealed multi-faith village behind a prayer barrier.

name: Witchwillow Range
description: Willow groves and corrupted nature spirits.

name: Hope's Fall
description: Imaru's Tower. Rotsworn. Sealed until three curse shards.

name: Coalridge Pass
description: Coal on ridge walls and in caves. Skeletons, zogres, dragon wolves, green dragons.
approx: nw of silverthorn keep, ne of the lake

name: Silverthorn Keep
description: Fallen Wild Knights fortress. Gate into Dowdun Reach. One curse seal.

name: The Approach … The Bastion
description: Named keep districts: Approach, Courtyard, Nexus, Library, Grand Hall, Garrison, Pastures, Menagerie, Crypt, Lake, Demon Gate, Cathedral, Bastion. Bastion door opens Umbral Sands.

name: Alcarrid Oasis
description: First desert camp from the Bastion. Youngest Moon Garou clan. Icthlarin.

name: Dunes of Uzzer
description: Weaving clan. Forbidden Scrolls. Vault (Mirrors) at a pyramid north of here.

name: Manafem Plains
description: Clan that avoids open dunes. Hunted by The Radiant (red dragon). Vault (Kalphite) south at a pyramid.

name: The Burning Spire
description: Fuzan's volcano. Corrupted Lens. Cave of Screams.

name: Rasthin's Rest
description: Only buildable / safe hub in the raid.

name: Dragontail Vines
description: First raid path. Runite and luminite on the way. Anima pylons.

name: Fragments of Ghornfell
description: Garou/goblin fragment, black dragon, sanguine urn.

name: The Shattered Stronghold
description: Water/air/fire anima barriers, PL 9 Rat King.

name: Cataclysm Keep
description: Vault guardians, anima-button puzzle (Air, Water, Earth, Fire).

name: Kuldra's Sanctum
description: Dragon Gate into Kuldra. More runite/luminite on the approach.
